title: Contour-aware region-of-interest tracking of deforming soft tissue for endoscopic surgical navigation: source code, configuration templates and result summaries
description: Source code, configuration templates, analysis scripts, aggregate online-tracking result summaries and sequence-level out-of-fold split manifests for a contour-aware verification and arbitration layer around the OpenCV NanoTrack tracker, evaluated on CholecSeg8k, Kvasir-Instrument, a controlled chessboard benchmark and the public TrackVes soft-tissue tracking dataset. The repository does not redistribute third-party datasets.
